name: Oren Farhi
title: Senior Front End Engineer / Tech Lead
summary: As a seasoned front-end engineer with over two decades of experience, I build high-performance, scalable, and user-friendly web applications. I have a strong foundation in software architecture and hands-on experience with modern technologies including TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Redux (RTK), React Query, and styling solutions such as Chakra UI (with Emotion), Tailwind, and PandaCSS. In recent years, I’ve been incorporating AI-assisted coding tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude into my workflow to move faster, explore solutions, and reduce friction - while still relying on solid engineering judgment to ensure quality and maintainability. I care about writing clean, reliable code and creating user experiences that feel fast and intuitive across devices. I’m also the author of "Reactive Programming with Angular and NGRX".
